changes.en: A monitored folder on a drive that is unplugged, a network that is away or a folder that cannot be read is no longer taken for "everything deleted": its files keep their history, a banner names the folder, monitoring carries on when it is back, and "It was deleted…" lists its files as deleted only when you say so
changes.zh: 监控的文件夹所在的移动硬盘被拔出、网络断开或文件夹暂时无法读取时，不再被当作“全部删除”：文件的历史保留，横幅会指出是哪个文件夹，它回来后自动继续监控；只有你点“它已被删除…”确认后，里面的文件才会列为已删除

changes.en: Find deleted files: one button lists every file that was deleted and is still missing, newest first, each with Restore
changes.zh: 找回已删除的文件：一个按钮列出所有被删除、至今仍不在原处的文件，最近删除的在前，每个都带“恢复”按钮

changes.en: Restoring writes the whole version to a temporary file first and then puts it in place in one step; a file open in another program (for example Word) is left untouched with a clear message, and paths over 260 characters work
changes.zh: 恢复时先把整个版本写入临时文件，再一步放到位；目标文件被其他程序（例如 Word）打开时保持原样并给出明确提示；超过 260 个字符的路径也能恢复

changes.en: New versions are named by SHA-256; versions kept before stay readable under their SHA-1 names, an unchanged file reuses its old copy, and Duplicates and move detection compare old and new names
changes.zh: 新的版本副本以 SHA-256 命名；之前保存的版本仍按 SHA-1 名称读取，未变化的文件沿用旧副本，重复文件和移动检测能对比新旧两种名称

changes.en: Temporary-file cleanup leaves alone files changed in the last two days (was one hour) and never removes recovery copies or unsaved drafts of Office, WPS and other editors, however old
changes.zh: 临时文件清理不再动两天内修改过的文件（原为一小时），并且无论多旧都不删除 Office、WPS 等编辑软件的恢复副本和未保存的草稿

changes.en: After a cleanup, "Put them back" stays available in Clean up as long as the Recycle Bin is not emptied, instead of a 10-second offer
changes.zh: 清理后，“放回原处”会一直留在“空间清理”中（只要回收站没有清空），不再是 10 秒内的临时按钮

changes.en: Plainer words: the history view is called "History & restore", protection labels say "No copy yet" and what that means, the "no earlier version" note is in everyday language, caches are labelled "Deleted directly · programs do not need them" instead of a red warning, and chart titles no longer say "estimated"
changes.zh: 用词更直白：历史视图改名为“历史与找回”；保护状态写“暂无副本”并说明含义；“没有更早的版本”的说明改为日常用语；缓存标为“直接删除 · 程序已不再需要”，不再用红色警告；图表标题不再写“估算”

changes.en: After the PC wakes up, the catch-up rescan and background preparation wait a little, so DeskTrace never competes with you right after opening the lid
changes.zh: 电脑从睡眠中唤醒后，补充扫描和后台准备会稍等片刻再进行，刚打开笔记本时桌迹不会和你抢资源

changes.en: First-run guide: the restored test file shows a short highlight
changes.zh: 入门向导：找回测试文件后有短暂的高亮提示

changes.en: Showing the current content of an online-only cloud file no longer downloads it
changes.zh: 查看“仅联机”云文件的当前内容时不再触发下载

changes.en: Changing settings while a drive is unplugged no longer drops its folder from the monitored list
changes.zh: 移动硬盘拔出时修改设置，不再把它的文件夹从监控列表中删掉
